description: Which bytes a non-ASCII password must be for pdf.js to open an RC4 128-bit (R3) PDF, the kind pdf.protect makes.

notes.text: The PDF is encrypted here by the spec's own algorithms (ISO 32000-1, 7.6.3), so no Ghostscript is needed.
A one-page PDF encrypted with R3, 128-bit RC4, whose user password is exactly `userBytes`.
What Ghostscript would have been given through -sUserPassword=café in a UTF-8 argfile.
